exposes.name: Battery low
exposes.description: Indicates if the battery of this device is almost empty.

exposes.name: Voltage
exposes.description: Voltage of the battery in millivolts.

exposes.name: LED config (top left short press)
exposes.description: Specifies LED color (rgb) and pattern on short press as hex string. 0-2: RGB value (e.g. ffffff = white) 3: Light position (01=top, 02=bottom, 00=full) 4-7: Durations for sequence fade-in -> on -> fade-out -> off (e.g. 01020102) 8: Number of Repetitions (01=1 to ff=255) Example: ff1493000104010001.
